sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate implements the prior applicability and owner/path repairs, but the readiness SPARQL does not enforce complete quantity cardinality. For each lower and upper interpolation point, require exactly one interpolationPointCoordinate resource and exactly one interpolationPointResult resource, and require each resource to have exactly one qudt:numericValue and exactly one qudt:unit where the canonical unit is declared. Likewise require exactly one qudt:numericValue and exactly one qudt:unit on the interpolatedNetPlateThickness quantity, and exactly one numeric value and unit on each longitudinal and transverse calculation-case thickness.
